name: support_routing
description: Route a customer support ticket to the right team

question.instructions: Which team should handle this customer support ticket?

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, refunds, payment methods, pricing or subscription plan changes.
criteria.technical: Bugs, errors, crashes, performance problems, integrations or anything not working as designed.
criteria.account: Login, passwords, two-factor authentication, profile details, account access, ownership or deletion.
criteria.shipping: Delivery status, tracking, lost or damaged packages, delivery addresses and returns logistics.
criteria.other: Feedback, feature requests, partnerships, general questions or anything that fits no other team.
